title: Sunset Orbit: staged readiness cascade and release orchestration for version decommission
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-level plan to retire v1.x of the runtime API using a staged 'orbit' approach: define cohorts, freeze compatibility guarantees, publish migration artifacts, coordinate release notes across Console, SDKs, Docs, and Customer Success, and execute a controlled ramp-down with automated in-product guidance and a rollback tether. Goal: minimize customer disruption while reclaiming deprecated capacity and simplifying routing logic in the serving runtime.
tasks: Draft public timeline and FAQ for external customers
Create migration guide with code samples for REST and SDKs (Python/Node/Go)
Coordinate Console UI banners and rollout stages (canary -> gradual -> final)
Align SDK owners on warnings: telemetry, deprecation header, and opt-in compatibility shim
Prepare Dedicated customers runbook and private deployment upgrade checklist
Schedule cross-functional runway review: Eng, Security, Docs, CS, Legal
Assemble release notes package and GTM snippets for Growth & Sales
Instrument metrics and alerting for migration regressions and error spikes
Create rollback playbook and feature-flag gate for immediate re-enable
acceptance_criteria: Public timeline and FAQ published in docs.redwood.com with links from Console
Migration guide covers >=95% of customer API call patterns in telemetry sampling
SDKs emit deprecation warnings and include migration helper functions
Console banners tested in staging and validated by UX and Accessibility teams
Dedicated/Private customers contacted and provided upgrade/runbook materials
Automated canary shows <1% error delta and latency impact <5ms before staged cutovers
Rollback tested end-to-end and runbook dry-run completed with SRE on-call
risks: Customers running pinned private deployments may miss notices — require CS outreach
Unexpected compatibility regressions in third-party SDK forks
Telemetry gaps that hide migration failure modes
Release notes mis-synchronization across channels (Console vs Email vs Docs)

2025-04-15: Hard disable of v1.x endpoints per public timeline (subject to rollback)
